lines: {~hail}, {~friend}. Didn't hear you come up. Easy on the crops.
{~hail}, {~friend}. You've the look of someone who goes where others won't.

lines.text: {~hail}, {player}. Always good to see an old friend.
Still wandering this late, {~friend}? Come closer to the light.

lines: {~hail}, {~friend}. Come rest your feet a moment.
